rationale: A single StackExchange post constitutes the entire evidence base. Broad web research reveals the pain is real but infrequent, well-served by free methods, and shows no meaningful willingness-to-pay signal for a dedicated paid tool. The core technique (temporary 410 sitemap + GSC URL removal) is thoroughly documented free knowledge; competitors charge for adjacent SEO suites rather than this specific workflow, undermining any pricing thesis at $29–$49.
